sample_unit: children with newly diagnosed ulcerative colitis

links.outcome: External prospective validation accuracy of published paediatric UC outcome prediction models versus original reports
links.effect: PROTECT AUC for steroid-free remission was 0.78 at 3 months but 0.57 at 12 months. Schechter criteria sensitivity/specificity/PPV/NPV were 50%/60%/35%/74%. Only PUCAI predicted acute severe colitis.
links.quote: The other predictive models did not achieve sufficient accuracy, which was far from that reported in the original studies.

screen.reason: Prospective multicenter external validation of previously published clinical predictive models for paediatric ulcerative colitis outcomes.
